blocks.text: The spookiest time of the year is here. Halloween brings to mind images of people around the world dressing up as monstrous creatures or characters from popular culture and folklore. They roam streets, malls, schools, and offices dressed up as ghosts, goblins, and other monstrosities. In the Philippines, some masquerade as kapre, aswang, and white ladies, or impersonate celebrities or political figures — all done in the name of fun and sweets. But Halloween’s origins are far from fun and games, and date back to Europe over 2,000 years ago. So, have you ever wondered how Halloween came to be? Here’s […]...
